description:
Use this when the user wants to know which clip to post first, why a clip was picked, or whether it is ready
to post: "which clip should I post first", "is this good enough to post", "does it pass the campaign rules".
Per clip: score (0-1) and rank in its batch, reasons, transcript, position in the source, why_it_should_work
and "ok:" or "fix:" checks (hook, dead air, captions, length, watermark). The score ranks clips against each
other; it is not a forecast of views, so do not present it as one.
Not for: listing clips (list_clips) or results after posting (why_it_worked). Free and read only.

campaign_max_seconds.description: Campaign maximum clip length in seconds; 0 is none.

campaign_min_seconds.description: Campaign minimum clip length in seconds; 0 is none.

clip_ids.description: Clip ids from list_clips, up to 20.

hashtags.description: Hashtags the caption must carry, e.g. ["#ad"].

job_id.description: A finished clip job, to explain all its clips. Give this or clip_ids.

must_say.description: Words or names the clip must say.
